YOUR FIELD NOTES

How to be an explorer

  1. Read the map key. Each icon stands for a kind of place. The same icons appear on the island and in your clues.
  2. Solve the clue. Tap the marker that matches. Some clues ask you to compare nearby places.
  3. Follow the paths. On route missions, start at the explorer and visit the symbols in order along the dotted paths.
  4. Find the treasure. Six map pieces reveal one final route. There is no timer and you can always ask for a hint.

North is up, east is right. “Beside” means connected by a dotted path.
